nodes.name: wiz_claw.h
nodes.summary: Core shared header for the wiz-claw AI agent library, defining common error codes (wiz_claw_err_t), overridable logging macros (WIZ_CLAW_LOG_I/W/E), and the heap string formatting utility wiz_claw_dup_printf. Has no external project-internal dependencies, making it the foundational base included by all other wiz-claw headers.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses standard C only (stddef.h, stdint.h, stdbool.h, stdio.h, stdlib.h, string.h, stdarg.h) with no ESP-IDF or Pico SDK dependencies, making it portable across build environments. Logging macros are designed to be overridden via #ifndef guards.

nodes.name: wiz_claw_dup_printf
nodes.summary: Heap-allocates a formatted string using vsnprintf with a two-pass approach (first pass to compute required size, second pass to fill the buffer), returning a caller-owned char pointer or NULL on failure.

nodes.name: wiz_claw_http.h
nodes.summary: HTTP/1.1 client interface header for the wiz-claw library, declaring low-level TCP helpers (connect, close, send, recv) and high-level HTTP callback functions compatible with LLM and Telegram transport function pointer signatures. Defines socket number assignments and configurable buffer size constants for header and body data.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses function-pointer-based transport injection pattern: wiz_claw_http_post_cb and wiz_claw_http_call_cb can be assigned directly to wiz_claw_llm_config_t.http_post and wiz_claw_tg_config_t.http_call respectively, enabling clean separation of HTTP transport from protocol logic.

nodes.name: wiz_claw_net.h
nodes.summary: Network initialization, DNS resolution, and DHCP helper header for the wiz-claw library, wrapping ioLibrary_Driver's DNS and DHCP modules with wiz-claw error types. Declares configuration struct and API functions for DNS lookup, DHCP lease acquisition, and the required 1-second periodic tick handler.
nodes.languageNotes: Depends on ioLibrary_Driver's wizchip_conf.h for the wiz_NetInfo type; must be called after wizchip_initialize() and network_initialize(). The wiz_claw_net_1s_tick() function must be wired into a 1-second timer ISR or polling loop.

nodes.name: wiz_claw_telegram.h
nodes.summary: Telegram Bot API client interface header defining types and function declarations for polling updates, parsing incoming messages, and sending text replies. HTTP transport is injected via the wiz_claw_http_call_fn function pointer, keeping TLS and socket concerns outside this module.
nodes.languageNotes: The wiz_claw_tg_message_t struct uses a heap-allocated text field requiring explicit wiz_claw_tg_message_free() cleanup. The polling offset (inout_next_offset) follows the Telegram long-polling pattern of tracking update_id+1 to avoid reprocessing.

nodes.name: wiz_claw_tls.h
nodes.summary: mbedTLS client interface header for the wiz-claw library, providing a TLS session context struct (wiz_claw_tls_t) that wraps mbedTLS entropy, CTR-DRBG, SSL, and X.509 certificate objects alongside a WIZnet socket number. Declares the full TLS lifecycle API: init, connect, write, read, close, and free.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses RP2350 hardware TRNG (pico/rand.h get_rand_32()) as the entropy source for CTR-DRBG. The wiz_claw_tls_t struct (~1-2 KB) is explicitly documented as too large for stack allocation and should be declared as a global or static variable. CA bundle loading is conditional on WIZ_CLAW_CA_BUNDLE_PEM being defined.
